scenario: User original network; input1098 volumes times0.8; all other demand, routing, native signals and desired-speed distributions preserved
scope: Canonical freeway METANET component, both directions, eight physical ramp entry/exit positions. Not a whole coupled urban-MPC or lever benefit validation.
conditioned_diagnostic: Future measured admitted mainline flow, ramp release, off-ramp flow-derived capacity/split and physical connector stock may be used only as explicitly labeled exogenous diagnostic support. Future mainline N/rho/speed is never injected.
history_forecast: At each cutoff use only initial state, completed 150-second boundary flow history, and known saved input timetable. Predict admitted mainline interface flow from recent admission rate subject to known demand plus an external backlog estimate derived from past expected demand minus past admitted flow. Hold recent ramp releases and off-ramp capacity/splits, and cutoff connector stock, fixed over450seconds. Future realized source/ramp/off flows or stock are prohibited. Forecasting full urban queues is outside this component experiment.
origin_queue_scope: The estimated native external input backlog remains in boundary-forecast metadata; it is not a measured state. The canonical component origin starts at0 because effective admitted interface requests, not all external desired demand, are supplied to it. Any subsequently rejected interface flow is retained by the canonical origin queue.
initial_state: One observed state at each cutoff. Preserve initial vehicle count; use canonical density representation for the existing continuity equation and report physical exposure separately. No state reset during a450-second prediction.
parameters: Fit existing FD free-speed/critical-density multipliers and existing tau,nu,kappa,merge coefficient separately by direction. Keep FD family, lane-drop phi, and capacity-drop settings fixed; no artificial lever rewards.
freeze: Hash parameter artifact, model harness, boundary factory, extractor, protocol, fitting/evaluation definitions and imported physical source/geometry before extracting or evaluating seed17 traffic outcomes. Runtime completion metadata alone is not traffic evaluation.
metrics: congestion threshold agreement and first crossing timing within horizon
congestion_rule: Observed and predicted cell n>=5 and mean speed<30km/h at five consecutive30-second snapshots spanning120seconds; missing/empty speed not zero
comparison: Current canonical parameter baseline versus seed13-calibrated parameters with identical initialization and boundary protocol; also initial-state persistence speed/density baseline
failure_reporting: Retain failed or infeasible rollouts. Do not score only successful/favorable windows; expose missing frames, negative/nonfinite state, conservation errors, unaccepted requested boundary flow and absent physical-flow capture. No tuning after inspecting seed17.
predeclared_interpretation: Report all windows and both modes. Success in conditioned replay only identifies internal component improvement, not deployable forecasting. One unseen seed is a limited independent check, not general validation or MPC improvement proof.
